# Webhooks

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Jira webhooks send HTTP POST notifications to an external URL when events
occur (issue created, status changed, comment added, etc.).

## jira webhook list

List configured webhooks.

**Alias:** `ls`

### Usage

```
jira webhook list [flags]
```

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
jira webhook list
jira webhook list --json
```

---

## jira webhook view

Display details for a webhook.

### Usage

```
jira webhook view <webhook-id> [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira webhook view 10001
jira webhook view 10001 --json
```

---

## jira webhook create

Register a new webhook.

### Usage

```
jira webhook create [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `-n` | Webhook name |
| `--url` | `-u` | Target URL to receive webhook payloads |
| `--event` | `-e` | Event to subscribe to (repeatable); e.g. `jira:issue_created` |
| `--jql` | | JQL filter — only send events matching this query |
| `--secret` | `-s` | Shared secret for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification |
| `--enabled` | | Enable the webhook immediately (default true) |

### Common Events

| Event | Description |
|---|---|
| `jira:issue_created` | A new issue was created |
| `jira:issue_updated` | An issue was updated (any field) |
| `jira:issue_deleted` | An issue was deleted |
| `comment_created` | A comment was added |
| `comment_updated` | A comment was edited |
| `comment_deleted` | A comment was deleted |
| `worklog_created` | A worklog was added |
| `worklog_updated` | A worklog was updated |
| `worklog_deleted` | A worklog was deleted |
| `attachment_created` | An attachment was added |
| `attachment_deleted` | An attachment was deleted |
| `jira:version_released` | A version was released |
| `sprint_created` | A sprint was created |
| `sprint_started` | A sprint was started |
| `sprint_closed` | A sprint was closed |

### Examples

```bash
# Listen for issue creation and update
jira webhook create \
  --name "CI Notifier" \
  --url https://ci.example.com/jira-hook \
  --event jira:issue_created \
  --event jira:issue_updated

# Scoped to bugs only
jira webhook create \
  --name "Bug Alerts" \
  --url https://alerts.example.com/bugs \
  --event jira:issue_created \
  --jql "project = MYPROJ AND issuetype = Bug" \
  --secret "$WEBHOOK_SECRET"
```

## jira webhook delete

Delete a webhook.

### Usage

```
jira webhook delete <webhook-id> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | | Skip confirmation prompt |

### Examples

```bash
jira webhook delete 10001
jira webhook delete 10001 --confirm
```
